name: Avatar
description: A person's image with initials or custom fallback content while it is missing, pending or broken.

src.description: Image URL; the fallback stands in while it is missing, pending or broken.

name.description: The person's full name: the accessible name, and the initials when `fallback` is absent.

fallback.description: Text or rich content shown instead of initials while the image is unavailable.

fallbackDelay.description: Milliseconds a pending image waits before the fallback shows; a missing or broken image shows it at once.

aria.nativeElement: A span with role=img and the complete person name; the inner native image has empty alt to avoid duplicate announcements.
notes: The name prop labels both loaded and fallback states. Override with aria-label or aria-labelledby, or use aria-hidden for a decorative avatar beside a visible name.
fallback accepts text or React content; omitted fallback derives initials from name.
Avatar uses shared control geometry for compact identity chips.
Avatar derives fallback initials from name; custom fallback content should stay icon or text sized to the same control box.
